description: Four board corners: the 2 nearest connectors per adjacent side (16 physical 2x16 MPO connectors, every hole within 18.375 mm of its corner) and every connection touching them, with R=15 mm template margins and the radius / template-family / conflict / 3D judgement.
corner_definition: 2 connectors per corner side with the smallest minimum port-to-corner distance

template_definitions.adjacent: single-arc L: legs = b-R / a-R, both >= 0
template_definitions.opposite: delta=0 straight | 0<delta<2R short-S pair (theta=acos(1-delta/2R) per arc) | delta>=2R two 90deg arcs + middle straight delta-2R

judgement_definitions.radius_limited_2d: no 2D template in the frozen family satisfies R=15 (proven by the listed inequality)
judgement_definitions.pure90_template_limited: pure two-90deg-turn template cannot generate it; the frozen short-S pair (arcs of theta<90deg) can
judgement_definitions.rigid_template_conflict_needs_3d: the single possible 2D template (adjacent L, no free parameter) has parallel spacing conflicts with other canonical templates; needs compound template or 3D layer change -> 3D search
judgement_definitions.conflict_needs_joint_search: a 2D template exists but its representative geometry conflicts with other canonical templates; solvable only by joint routing search, not by single-connection geometry
judgement_definitions.not_limited: template exists and representative geometry is 0.08 mm clear of all other canonical templates

incidence_counts.note: a connection between two corner connectors of different corners is listed once per corner; unique counts are above

collision_analysis.method: canonical representative template centrelines sampled at 0.10 mm; KD-tree radius 0.11 mm; nearby point pairs with tangent angle < 5.0 deg counted as parallel spacing conflicts (>= 5.0 deg would be permitted designed crossings)

adjacent_rigid_template.method: all 400 unique single-arc L centrelines sampled at 0.05 mm; point pairs closer than 0.08 mm whose tangent angle is < 5.0 deg (parallel) are counted; a pair with >= 1 mm of such parallel coincidence is reported as a substantial rigid-template conflict (crossings are permitted and not counted)

template_definitions.radius_limited_2d: no template of the frozen family reaches R=15 (proven by the per-connection inequality)
template_definitions.pure90_template_limited: pure two-90deg-turn template cannot generate the connection; the frozen two-arc short-S pair can
template_definitions.rigid_template_conflict: the unique single-arc L of this adjacent pair comes closer than 0.08 mm to another unique single-arc L; both cannot share one layer -> alternative template or 3D layer needed
template_definitions.same_u_family_capacity_limited: the frozen U family has only 4 middle-straight depth tracks and this side has more overlapping U intervals than tracks -> pigeonhole proves unavoidable coincidence; ordering/layer change needed
template_definitions.conflict_needs_joint_search: template exists with free parameters but the representative geometry conflicts; joint routing search needed (not single-connection geometry)
template_definitions.lift_limited: 2D template exists but no straight is long enough for the vertical S-lift to some routing layer
